creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The owner chose this on 2026-11-08 from the Lectern page muster-ui-redesign (now archived; version 3 holds every board): direction A for the agent list, direction B's Needs you strip on top of it, the strip and every tab foldable, the whole chord on every row, one-to-one conversations on their agent's row, flush pane headers, and the conversation and banner mock-ups as drawn. Muster takes on no theme: every new surface derives its colors from settings that already exist.

The decisions are in Fencil, from the discussion ui-redesign-2026-11: agent-list-rows, needs-you-strip, foldable-tabs, row-whole-chord, one-to-one-on-agent-row, pane-headers, chrome-colors and agent-identity-colors (`fencil show <id>`). The cards under this one are the parts that can be built separately.
title: 🎨 Muster UI redesign: direction A with the Needs you strip
